fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: the accessor builder (constructor inlined) and the destructors store vptr 0x7104f72a90

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: constructor stores the accessor; get_team_no goes through it to TeamModule (boma+0xd8); initialize/reset read the owner's battle object id at boma+0x8

fields.name: group_num
fields.evidence: get_group_num returns it; clean and clear_all loop 0..group_num over the 0x18 array; copied from the params with 0x18 by initialize (vtable 0x28)

fields.name: groups
fields.evidence: every per-group getter/setter indexes it by group with stride 0x34; set by initialize from the params

fields.name: shield_num
fields.evidence: copied from the params with 0x28 by initialize; the 0x20/0x28 pair is passed to the per-group update

fields.name: shields
fields.evidence: shield records (stride 0x50) indexed via group first-index + shield id in is_shield, set_size, set_status, set_shield_type, clear_all

fields.name: shield_used_count
fields.how: computed: sum of part sizes of added groups
fields.evidence: the two add-group methods (vtable 0x58, 0x60) give the group this value as first index then add its part size; clean zeroes it

fields.name: collision_list_node
fields.evidence: registration/list object: destructor and clean unlink it (f_71003e5ce0); the update (vtable 0x80) links it (f_71003e6440) when a group becomes active; vtable 0x1d8 returns its address

fields.name: collision_group_num
fields.evidence: initialize copies it with 0x50 from the params; sleep and the hit-log clears loop over it

fields.name: collision_groups
fields.evidence: array of 0x2d0-byte collision blocks indexed by group record +0x0; +0x30+8*i hold shape objects (target category/property bits written at shape +0x8/+0xc); +0x260/+0x268/+0x270 hit-log lists; get_center_pos asks a shape (vtable 0x20) for its centre

fields.name: active_group_num
fields.how: computed: last group with an active shield + 1
fields.evidence: set_status raises it to group+1 when a status is set; the update rewrites it as (last group that registered)+1; clean/reset zero it; the hit search (vtable 0x1c8) loops 0..it

fields.name: collision_kind
fields.evidence: from the params in initialize; (1<<kind)&0x7f written into shape flags, values 3 and 4 special-cased = COLLISION_KIND_REFLECTOR/ABSORBER (2 = COLLISION_KIND_SHIELD); constructor -1

fields.name: owner_object_id
fields.evidence: initialize stores the owner's battle object id; constructor default 0x50000000 = BATTLE_OBJECT_ID_INVALID; reset (vtable 0x38) rewrites it

fields.name: owner_category
fields.evidence: initialize stores object id >> 28; constructor 6 = COLLISION_CATEGORY_NONE

fields.name: team_info
fields.evidence: initialize stores the result of TeamModule (boma+0xd8) vtable 0x48

fields.name: unknown_70
fields.evidence: only zeroed (constructor u32 store over 0x70..0x73)

fields.name: no_team

fields.name: unknown_72
fields.evidence: cleared by initialize

fields.name: collision_category

fields.name: registered

fields.name: hit_flag

fields.name: clear_logs_on_reset

fields.name: sleep

pointers.to: shield records, stride 0x50, count probably at 0x20
collision blocks, stride 0x2d0, count at 0x48; +0x30+8*i shape objects, +0x248/+0x260/+0x268/+0x270 hit-log lists, +0x2c8 set by vtable 0x1f8

notes: One class only (vptr 0x7104f72a90, 184 bytes, no RTTI name); constructed inline in the accessor builder and stored at boma+0x100. ReflectorModule/AbsorberModule are also 184 bytes and share the collision-kind encoding (0x5c: 2/3/4 = SHIELD/REFLECTOR/ABSORBER). Slots the dossier left null, read from the vtable: set_turn 0xd0, set_hop 0xe0, set_no_team 0x158, sleep 0x1d0, set_hit_stop_slow 0x1e8. get_team_no is not a field: it tail-calls TeamModule (boma+0xd8) vtable 0x50. get_center_pos calls a shape object's vtable 0x20 and returns a vector. Unexported getters: vtable 0x138 hit_stop_mul, 0x168 shield type, 0x1f0 hit_stop_slow, 0x1d8 address of 0x38, 0x1e0 address of 0x88. Constructor values: 0x58=0, 0x5c=-1, 0x60=0x50000000, 0x64=6, 0x78=6, 0x7e=1, 0x80=0x84=1.0, 0x88/0x94/0xa4/0xa8=0x50000000, 0x8c/0x98=6, 0x90/0x9c/0xa0/0xac=-1, rest 0. Initialize (vtable 0x28) fills 0x10..0x28 and 0x48..0x5c from a params block, 0x60/0x64 from the owner object id, 0x68 from TeamModule. 0x88..0xaf is probably a last-hit record (object id/category pairs). 0x74 never written (padding).
